Thank you

parts:
Absolutely. Below is the syntax I have been working with. When trying to use "NA," I have taken out the "data$trafficr_r <- data %>% replace_with_na(replace=list(trafficr = 999))" lines. 


Syntax:

##CFA
library(naniar)
library(lavaan)
data = MGCFA_AI_WHITE_thisone

data$trafficr_r <- data %>% replace_with_na(replace=list(trafficr = 999))
data$carr_r <- data %>% replace_with_na(replace=list(carr = 999))
data$arrest_r <- data %>% replace_with_na(replace=list(arrest = 999))
data$money_r <- data %>% replace_with_na(replace=list(money = 999))
data$sch_r <- data %>% replace_with_na(replace=list(sch = 999))
data$scwrk_r <- data %>% replace_with_na(replace=list(scwrk = 999))
data$kids_r <- data %>% replace_with_na(replace=list(kids = 999))
data$rents_r <- data %>% replace_with_na(replace=list(rents = 999))
data$friend_r <- data %>% replace_with_na(replace=list(friend = 999))
data$pass_r <- data %>% replace_with_na(replace=list(pass = 999))
data$mem_r <- data %>% replace_with_na(replace=list(mem = 999))
data$broke_r <- data %>% replace_with_na(replace=list(broke = 999))
data$job_r <- data %>% replace_with_na(replace=list(job = 999))
Group1factor <- 'factor1=~ trafficr_r + carr_r + arrest_r + money_r + sch_r + scwrk_r + kids_r + rents_r + friend_r + pass_r + mem_r + broke_r + job_r'
fit1 <- cfa (Group1factor, ordered= c("trafficr_r", "carr_r", "arrest_r", "money_r", "sch_r", "scwrk_r", "kids_r", "rents_r", "friend_r", "pass_r", "mem_r", "broke_r", "job_r"),
            data = data)
summary(fit1, fit.measures = TRUE)
mi <- modindices(fit1, sort.=TRUE)

##configural 
fit2 <- cfa(Group1factor, ordered= c("trafficr", "carr", "arrest", "money", "sch", "scwrk", "kids", "rents", "friend", "pass", "mem", "broke", "job"), data = data, group = "AI")
summary(fit2, fit.measures = TRUE, std=TRUE)
##Metric
fit2.1 <- cfa(Group1factor,ordered= c("trafficr", "carr", "arrest", "money", "sch", "scwrk", "kids", "rents", "friend", "pass", "mem", "broke", "job"), 
            data = data, 
            group = "AI",
            group.equal = c("loadings"))
summary(fit2.1, fit.measures= TRUE, std=TRUE)


Output:

> mi <- modindices(fit1, sort.=TRUE)
> ##configural 
> fit2 <- cfa(Group1factor, ordered= c("trafficr", "carr", "arrest", "money", "sch", "scwrk", "kids", "rents", "friend", "pass", "mem", "broke", "job"), data = data, group = "AI")
Error in complete.cases(data[all.idx]) : 
  not all arguments have the same length
> summary(fit2, fit.measures = TRUE, std=TRUE)
Error in summary(fit2, fit.measures = TRUE, std = TRUE) : 
  object 'fit2' not found
> Group1factor <- 'factor1=~ trafficr_r + carr_r + arrest_r + money_r + sch_r + scwrk_r + kids_r + rents_r + friend_r + pass_r + mem_r + broke_r + job_r'
> fit1 <- cfa (Group1factor, ordered= c("trafficr_r", "carr_r", "arrest_r", "money_r", "sch_r", "scwrk_r", "kids_r", "rents_r", "friend_r", "pass_r", "mem_r", "broke_r", "job_r"),
+             data = data)
Error: Must use a vector in `[`, not an object of class matrix.


Thank you!
